recipe.visualDefinition: A studio group portrait of six musicians in 1970s attire, framed by a distinctive blue and white diagonal-striped border, featuring bold, italicized futuristic typography at the top and Roman numeral sequencing.
coreVisualRelationships: The diagonal border creates a high-energy frame that contains the static group pose.
The cyan display type at the top contrasts sharply with the neutral studio background.
The brass instruments (trumpet and trombone) act as horizontal and diagonal visual anchors.
The pyramid-like arrangement of the subjects creates a balanced, multi-layered composition.
coreInvariants: Blue and white diagonal-striped border frame
Italicized, outlined display typography with a horizontal speed-line effect
High-key studio lighting with soft shadows
1970s fashion palette including white suits, black velvet, and patterned scarves

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Six subjects arranged in two rows; the top row is centered and slightly smaller, the bottom row is larger and fills the foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure in the white hat and the large cyan title at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold title, moves down through the central figure's trumpet, circles through the faces of the group, and settles on the trombone at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the subjects and instruments fill approximately 85% of the frame against a light gray/white backdrop.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: White and light gray (background and clothing) providing a clean canvas.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black and dark brown (hair and suits) providing depth and definition.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value, low-saturation background allows the high-saturation cyan title to pop forward.

letterConstructionRules: Horizontal bar extensions on the first and last characters
characterSpecificRedesigns: The initial 'S' features a long horizontal top bar extending across the width of the word.
The final 'h' features a tail that mirrors the initial 'S' bar.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing between a custom, futuristic display face and a traditional, high-contrast serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 70s futuristic tech aesthetic of the main title.
Matches the high-contrast serif style of the Roman numerals.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of six men with 1970s hairstyles and fashion (white suits, black velvet jackets) against a light gray background. One man in a white hat holds a gold trumpet upward. A gold trombone lies across the bottom foreground. Frame the entire image with a border of diagonal blue and white stripes.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, cyan-colored, italicized, and horizontally stretched title at the top with a thick black outline. Add black Roman numerals in a high-contrast serif font on the right side.

verificationChecks: Is the border composed of diagonal stripes?
Is the main title cyan with a black outline?
Are the subjects arranged in a multi-layered group pose?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original band members
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the cyan title is the most prominent element.
Verify the diagonal border is consistent around all four sides.
Check that the brass instruments look metallic and reflective.
Confirm the 70s hairstyles are voluminous and period-accurate.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-key group studio portrait with a geometric striped border and ultra-wide italicized display type for a classic 70s funk aesthetic.
